title: Studio Interfaces: the navigation-item inspector cannot author `visible` (shown read-only), `viewName`, `recordId` / `recordMode`, `filters`, `badge` / `badgeVariant`, `requires*` or `order` — the Setup AppNavInspector has them
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect, reproduced, landing site named.
Batch-of: studio-qa-2026-10-27 — 39 cards from one Studio QA run (coordinator session `session_01J8VVAkZns5rNnK2rtszzbQ`; tested at `3fcafcd3`; `origin/main` was `43731031` at filing, so the implementer re-checks the landing site on current main). The run record is the `qa-run` issue filed with this batch.

## Symptom

A builder can add a nav entry in Studio but cannot point it at a specific view or record, gate it, badge it or order it; those keys are live at runtime (API-written they all work).

## Reproduction

1. Interfaces › an app › a nav item → inspector shows "visible when" as display-only text and no controls for the other keys.
2. `PUT /api/v1/meta/app/…?mode=draft` with `visible`, `viewName`, `recordId`, `filters`, `badge`, `requiresObject` on an entry → publish → each takes effect in the console (L3 pass).

## Expected

Studio's nav inspector offers the same keys as `metadata-admin` AppNavInspector.

## Suspected landing site (the implementer verifies)

`StudioNavItemInspector` (ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/) vs `metadata-admin` AppNavInspector.

## Filing facts

- reach: Studio UI, measured by the Interfaces QA card.
- Business reason: Navigation is the app's front door; builders must drop to Setup or JSON for common needs.
- Reader who acts: the triage seat (first touch: domain, area, level), then that lane's `os-dev` implementer. QA suggestion only: `domain:ui`, `area:studio`, p2.
- Dedupe: semantic search `Studio nav item inspector cannot edit visible viewName recordId filters badge requiresObject` on objectstack-ai/objectstack → 1 hit (closed #16875, a docblock).
- QA id: U11
